{{short description|Legislative district of the Philippines}} {{Infobox constituency |name = Southern Leyte's 1st congressional district |parl_name = [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |image = Ph fil sp leyte 1d.png |caption = Boundary of the congressional district in the province |image2 = |caption2 = |district_label = Province |district = [[Southern Leyte]] |region_label = Region |region = [[Eastern Visayas]] |population = 201,421 (2020){{PH census|2020}} |electorate = 133,753 (2022){{cite web|url=https://comelec.gov.ph/?r=2022NLE/Statistics/2022RVVAVmcocfinal|title=Number and Turn-Out of Registered Voters and Voters Who Actually Voted by City/Municipality May 9, 2022 National and Local Elections|website=Commission on Elections|accessdate=June 10, 2023}} |area = {{convert|603.91|km2|abbr=on}} |towns = {{Collapsible list | titlestyle = font-weight:normal;text-align:left;background-color:WhiteSmoke; | title = 7 [[Local government in the Philippines|LGU]]s | '''Cities''' | [[Maasin, Southern Leyte|Maasin]] | '''Municipalities''' | [[Bontoc, Southern Leyte|Bontoc]] | [[Limasawa]] | [[Macrohon, Southern Leyte|Macrohon]] | [[Malitbog, Southern Leyte|Malitbog]] | [[Padre Burgos, Southern Leyte|Padre Burgos]] | [[Tomas Oppus, Southern Leyte|Tomas Oppus]] }} |year = 2019 |members_label = Representative |members = [[Roger Mercado]] |blank1_name = Political party |blank1_info = {{Color box|{{party color|Partido Federal ng Pilipinas}}|border=darkgray}} [[Partido Federal ng Pilipinas|PFP]] |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank2_info = Majority }} '''Southern Leyte's 1st legislative district''' is one of the two [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Southern Leyte]]. The district has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|lower house]] of the Congress since 2022.{{Cite web|title=LIST: New congressional districts in the 2022 elections|url=https://www.rappler.com/philippines/elections/list-new-congressional-districts-philippines-2022-polls/|access-date=2021-09-17|website=Rappler|date=24 June 2021 |language=en}} Established in 2019, it is composed of the city of [[Maasin, Southern Leyte|Maasin]] and the municipalities of [[Bontoc, Southern Leyte|Bontoc]], [[Limasawa]], [[Macrohon, Southern Leyte|Macrohon]], [[Malitbog, Southern Leyte|Malitbog]], [[Padre Burgos, Southern Leyte|Padre Burgos]], and [[Tomas Oppus, Southern Leyte|Tomas Oppus]].{{cite news|title=Southern Leyte Split|url=https://www.abs-cbn.com/focus/02/06/19/southern-leyte-split|date=6 February 2019|website=ABS-CBN News|access-date=4 March 2022}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Roger Mercado]] of the [[Partido Federal ng Pilipinas]] (PFP).{{cite web|url=https://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=June 10, 2023}}{{cite news|url=https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/921556/members-of-lakas-cmd-in-romualdez-led-house-climb-to-109/story/|title=Members of Lakas-CMD in Romualdez-led House climb to 109|first=Llanesca|last=Panti|date=September 25, 2024|accessdate=September 27, 2024|work=[[GMA Integrated News]]}} == Representation history == {| class="wikitable" !
